args.title: Fix password reset email linking to localhost in production
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever process.env.PUBLIC_URL is not set, and this fallback is used to build the password reset link (and other links) in passwordResetEmail, rollupText, and scheduledExportEmail. If PUBLIC_URL isn't configured in the production environment (e.g. after last week's release changed deployment config), users receive reset emails pointing at localhost instead of the real public host.

Proposed fix: ensure PUBLIC_URL (or an equivalent production URL config value) is always set in the deployment environment, and/or change BASE_URL to read from a required config value (e.g. config.app.publicUrl) that fails fast or logs a clear error at startup if missing, rather than silently defaulting to localhost. This will prevent production emails from ever containing a localhost link.
